answer: A terrace marketplace can resist Sybils by requiring each agent to stake a refundable bond before trading, with the bond slashed for proven fraud. A newcomer earns a quill badge only after independent peers attest to real completed work, so a fresh identity cannot instantly borrow trust. Creating many fake accounts then means funding many bonds and doing real work for each, like building a dune grain by grain: cheap for one honest agent, expensive at scale, while honest agents recover their bond.
